details:
Q1: The fix the diagnosis suggests edits `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`. That file is outside this heal issue's scope marker, and implement's automation-path guard will reject it without an exact `files_touched` grant. How should scope be handled?
Choices:
A) Widen scope to `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`, `tests/test_conflict_manifest_union_contract.py` and a `changelog.d/` fragment, and add a deterministic template-twin resolution before resolver dispatch. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Keep the current scope (workflows/tests/changelog only). Add a regression test that pins today's fail-closed behaviour for host-only hook conflicts, plus a changelog note. No change to resolution behaviour; PR #6555 needs a human merge.
C) Close this heal issue with no code change: the refusal is by design (agents.md: "No model runs in either case"). Handle PR #6555's hook conflict by hand.
**Note:** Q2 applies only if Q1 = A.
Q2: Which conflicted host-only paths should the deterministic twin resolution cover? In every case it fires only when each side's live copy matches that side's `workflow-templates/` twin byte-for-byte, including executable mode, and the template merged cleanly. Every other case keeps failing closed with `sandbox_path_host_only`.
Choices:
A) Only `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`, the path in this incident.
B) Any conflicted `.claude/hooks/*.py` that has a `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/` twin. This also covers `gh_api_write_guard.py`, which has the same parity contract. (RECOMMENDED)
C) Any conflicted `.claude/**` path that has a `workflow-templates/.claude/**` twin and is not on the divergence allowlist (`.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json`).
Q3: When the twin resolution resolves the hook and other conflicts remain, what should happen?
Choices:
A) Stage the resolved hook and send only the remaining conflicts to the sandboxed resolver. This mirrors the manifest union-merge path. If the hook was the only conflict, commit the two-parent `[ai-merge-resolve]` merge directly. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Resolve the hook only when it is the sole conflicted path. Otherwise fail closed as today.
